name: Pasarón de la Vera (Spain)
description: Green field with a white stripe near the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pasarón de la Vera (a vulture on yellow, a chequy field and a boar).
history: Municipal flag of Pasarón de la Vera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pasarón de la Vera arms — vulture, chequy and boar
